product.title: Aspen's Off the Beaten Path Tour

description.text: Aspen is a city nestled in nature and soaked in history. Get a sense of how the city is situated in time and place with this walking tour. Stops include Victorian West End, John Denver Sanctuary, Wheeler Opera House, County Library, Arts Center. Stroll through the Victorian West End neighborhood and into the John Denver Sanctuary. Ideal for visitors basing in Aspen who want a guided mountain-town experience without coordinating meeting points, trailheads, or photo locations on their own.
